notes.text: Of the 17 jobs the CA 7 listing orders in table CARDDEMO, only CBPAUP0J is an AUTH JCL member; the other 16 have no JCL under this module's roots (the estate map places app/jcl in module CARDDEMO), so their chain-step-opaque asks stay open until that module is scanned.
CBPAUP0J is triggered by CLOSEFIL (TRIGGERED JOBS of CLOSEFIL names JOB=CBPAUP0J SCHID=030) and itself triggers POSTTRAN (JOB=POSTTRAN SCHID=030).

CBPAUP0J.STEP01 runs CBPAUP0C as an IMS BMP under PSB PSBPAUTB (PARM='BMP,CBPAUP0C,PSBPAUTB'). CBPAUP0C has an empty FILE-CONTROL, so none of the DSN-bearing DDs of the step (STEPLIB, DFSRESLB, PROCLIB, DFSSEL, IMS) is opened by the program; the pass lists them as disp-only reads, and whether IMS.SDFSRESL / IMS.PROCLIB / IMS.PSBLIB count as chain inputs is left open for the IMS system owner.

The job's only business data is the IMS database: CBPAUP0C walks PAUTSUM0 roots (GN) and their PAUTDTL1 children (GNP) and deletes them (DLET) through PCB PAUT-PCB-NUM; PSBPAUTB gives it PROCOPT=AP on DBD DBPAUTP0. No DD in the JCL allocates the database datasets (BMP region).
Run parameters come from in-stream SYSIN '00,00001,00001,Y', accepted into PRM-INFO; a non-numeric expiry-days value defaults to 5.

asks.message: CBPAUP0C takes IMS checkpoints (EXEC DLI CHKP ID(WK-CHKPT-ID)) every P-CHKP-FREQ summaries, but the JCL sets IEFRDER and IMSLOGR to DUMMY and nothing in the program reads a restart checkpoint on entry (no XRST); how the job is rerun after a failure is not stated by the JCL or the CA 7 listing
asks.request: Confirm the rerun procedure for CBPAUP0J after an abend (rerun from the start - deletions already committed at the last checkpoint are simply not found again - or a restart from a checkpoint id?)

notes.text: DBPAUTP0 runs no application program: STEPDEL (IEFBR14) deletes AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.IMSDATA.DBPAUTP0 and UNLOAD runs DFSRRC00 with PARM=(ULU,DFSURGU0,DBPAUTP0) over DDPAUTP0/DDPAUTX0 (OEM.IMS.IMSP.PAUTHDB / PAUTHDBX), the DD names DBD DBPAUTP0 and DBPAUTX0 declare. The toolbox does not parse this PARM form (chain-step-opaque: ims-parm), so the step's program is not catalogued.

DFSURGU1 (AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.IMSDATA.DBPAUTP0) is the step's output, not an input: DFSURGU1 is allocated new (DISP=(,CATLG,DELETE)) in the DFSRRC00 step whose PARM is (ULU,DFSURGU0,DBPAUTP0) and whose comment reads 'DOWNLOAD DBD DBPAUTP0'; STEPDEL deletes the same DSN first. The pass lists the DD as a disp-only read; mftb 0.2.1 applies a directions[] entry only to DDs bound to a program file, so the direction is recorded here as a note.
The GSAM output datasets are allocated DISP=(OLD,KEEP,KEEP): the job expects AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PAUTDB.ROOT.GSAM and .CHILD.GSAM to exist already, and no scanned job creates them.

DD PASFILOP is written, not read: DBUNLDGS inserts (CBLTDLI ISRT) each summary segment through PCB PASFLPCB; PSB DLIGSAMP's second PCB is GSAM DBD PASFLDBD with PROCOPT=LS, and that DBD names DD2=PASFILOP as its output DD; the program's own OPEN OUTPUT statements are commented out. The pass lists the DD as a disp-only read; mftb 0.2.1 applies a directions[] entry only to DDs bound to a program file, so the direction is recorded here as a note.

DD PADFILOP is written, not read: DBUNLDGS inserts (CBLTDLI ISRT) each detail segment through PCB PADFLPCB; PSB DLIGSAMP's third PCB is GSAM DBD PADFLDBD with PROCOPT=LS, and that DBD names DD2=PADFILOP as its output DD. The pass lists the DD as a disp-only read; mftb 0.2.1 applies a directions[] entry only to DDs bound to a program file, so the direction is recorded here as a note.

notes.text: UNLDPADB.STEP01 (PAUDBUNL under PSB PAUTBUNL, PROCOPT=GOTP) writes the root and child flat files AWS.M2.CARDDEMO.PAUTDB.ROOT.FILEO / .CHILD.FILEO that LOADPADB.STEP01 (PAUDBLOD) reads as INFILE1 / INFILE2; no scheduler table orders the two jobs, so the hand-off is a dataset fact, not a proven run order.
STEP0 (IEFBR14) deletes both output files with DISP=(OLD,DELETE,DELETE) before STEP01 recreates them NEW, so the job needs the files to exist from a previous run.

LOADPADB.STEP01 runs PAUDBLOD as a BMP under PSB PSBPAUTB (PARM='BMP,PAUDBLOD,PSBPAUTB'); the DDPAUTP0/DDPAUTX0 database DDs are commented out in the JCL. It inserts root segments from INFILE1 and child segments from INFILE2 with CBLTDLI ISRT.
